name: snow-ice
comment: BlockSnow, BlockSnowBlock, BlockIce (BlockSnow.java, BlockSnowBlock.java, BlockIce.java) on the Taiga platform of tick/weather-snow (seed 123: getEnableSnow on most columns of chunks (61,-13), (62,-13)). Rain from t=19 (set_weather), so the snow roll places layers where BlockSnow.canPlaceBlockAt allows: on stone and on a leaves patch (isOpaqueCube = !graphicsLevel, true here), not on a glass patch or on ice; still water cells in the platform (stone between them, so a freeze notifies no water) freeze. A snow layer set on glass breaks when a neighbour changes at t=40 (canSnowStay). Around a glowstone: two ice blocks two away (their own block light 14 - 3 = 11) melt into still water (above 11 - opacity 3), a snow layer two away (13) melts above 11 (no drop: quantityDropped 0); a snow block two away keeps block light 0 (opaque blocks store none) and stays. No snow is placed within light 10 of the glowstone and nothing else changes next to the melted water, so it never gets a neighbour change. block_box of the platform at t=100, 400 and the end (800 ticks), rng_state every tick.
